agenda_text:
CITY  OF  ALHAMBRA

  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE
  ALHAMBRA HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
  CITIZEN ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  (Notice No. N2M19-109)

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a special meeting of the Alhambra Housing And
Community Development Citizen Advisory (HCDA) Committee will be held on Monday,
December 9, 2019, commencing at 7:00 p.m., in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City
Hall, 111 South First Street, Alhambra, California, pursuant to the order of the Chairman of
the HCDA Committee, the Alhambra City Charter, the Alhambra Municipal Code, and Section
54956 of the Government Code of the State of California.

An agenda of such special meeting is attached hereto incorporated herein by reference and made
a part hereof as though fully set forth herein.

  LUCY GARCIA, ASSISTANT CITY MANAGER,
  HCDA COMMITTEE SECRETARY

Dated:  December 5, 2019
Notice No.  N2M19-109
   AGENDA
  SPECIAL MEETING
HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT CITIZEN ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  DECEMBER 9, 2019 AT 7:00 P.M.
  ALHAMBRA CITY HALL
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  111 S. FIRST ST.
  ALHAMBRA, CA 91801

  ROLL CALL:
  Bill Vallejos, Chair  Mark Lee, Vice Chair
  Steven Cosci  Carolyn Ortiz
  Bonita Sharma-Ngan  Marc Tousignant
  Eric Sunada  Conchita Bañuelos
  Marcos Sayon

1. DIRECTION ON CDBG AND HOME FUNDED PRIORITIES AND ACTIVITIES

  PLEASE NOTE: THIS ITEM WILL HEARD AS A JOINT MEETING WITH THE
  ALHAMBRA CITY COUNCIL AND APPEARS ON THE 12-9-19 ALHAMBRA CITY
  COUNCIL AGENDA AS ITEM NO. 4

  On September 23, 2019, the City Council approved the City’s Consolidated Annual
  Performance and Evaluation Report (CAPER) for the Community Development Block Grant
  (CDBG) and Home Investment Partnerships (HOME) Programs. The CAPER served to
  close out the 2018-19 CDBG and HOME performance year and/or the fourth year of the
  City’s Five-Year Consolidated Plan. In advance of the Council receiving the CAPER, a draft
  report was shared with the City’s HCDA Citizen Advisory Committee. The HCDA’s
  feedback suggested CDBG and HOME activity alternatives be explored.

  Staff is currently preparing for the development of the City’s new Five-Year Consolidated
  Plan for Housing and Community Development July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2025. In
  consideration, a joint meeting with the City Council and HCDA Committee has been
  convened to enable additional education and discussion of eligible activities and goals under
  CDBG and HOME. The Council is asked to determine if new or other focus areas and
  activities subject to CDBG and HOME need to be pursued; if so, specific Council policy
  direction is needed to enable the appropriate narrative to the City’s draft 2020-25
  Consolidated Plan and 2020-21 Action Plan. If the Council changes policy direction, the
  HCDA would be tasked with evaluating and establishing program accomplishments within
  the 2020-25 Consolidated Plan, and the HCDA would provide quarterly monitoring of the
  City’s program accomplishment status.

  Recommended Action:
  Committee members provide input relative to the City’s future priorities and eligible
  activities under the Community Development Block Grant Program (CDBG) and the Home
   Investment Partnerships Program (HOME).

2. ADJOURNMENT

Copies of the staff report or other written documentation relating to each item of business described herein
above are on file in the office of Management Services, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra,
CA, and are available for public inspection during regular office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 5:30 P.M., Monday
through Thursday.
Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described
herein, he or she may contact Mr. Matt Cuevas, either in person at the Management Services Department
located at City Hall, or call via telephone at (626) 570-5012, during regular business hours.
Americans with Disabilities Act: If you require special assistance to participate in any City meeting, please
contact the City Clerk's Office (626) 570-5090. Notification of at least 72 hours prior to the meeting will
enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting.
